proposals.title: Automatic dimension parity gate
proposals.proposed_change: Compare target Data Sheet H/W/D with layout manifest and rendered dimension labels before image QA.
proposals.regression_test: Fail if any image dimension text differs from canonical target-panel dimensions.

proposals.title: Gateway capacity topology gate
proposals.trigger: 32 indoor units + 6 outdoor systems exceeded unverified single-gateway architecture
proposals.proposed_change: Require endpoint inventory and manufacturer capacity matrix before gateway selection and BOM freeze.
proposals.regression_test: Fail when required addressed endpoints/systems exceed documented gateway topology capacity.

proposals.title: Plugin/repository capability recommender
proposals.trigger: Repeated requests for memory, research, calculations, CAD/3D and image tooling
proposals.proposed_change: Map capability gaps to installed ChatGPT plugins and governed open-source candidates, then propose only non-duplicative additions.
proposals.regression_test: Do not recommend already-installed tools or candidates without a defined project gap.

proposals.title: Source freshness/lifecycle watcher
proposals.trigger: Component lifecycle and manufacturer documentation may change
proposals.proposed_change: Schedule periodic non-authoritative source checks and create review proposals when official lifecycle/revision changes are detected.
proposals.regression_test: Never auto-change selected model; create a review/HOLD proposal only.
